# Inspection Clause

Prepares and attaches one inspection document at `bindings.document`, using single cardinality and the ordinary Documents lifecycle. The template must declare an inspector and nonempty inspection scope with standard `approved-scope-review`. Its inspection terms are frozen and must match on provision.

A usable inspection can describe a next action for the inspector until its result status is `recorded`; describing that action does not perform it. Preparation freezes a requirement before creation or provision. Provision requires the expected supplier, request correlation, requirement reference and initialized document origin. Normalized source, effective policy, every party role and identity, allowed value slots and approval requirements must match. An extra undeclared party is rejected even when the child acquired it through its own admission; a stored witness cannot authorize an expanded roster. An unrelated old field alone is not a rejection rule.

Selection is distinct from usability. General admission can seek authorized approval, the incoming participant's consent and access before linking. A selected child becomes usable only when its Activation is active and its source and reader requirements are ready. Identity substitution is rejected; matching retries do not create a second obligation.

Configuration references: `bindings.document` is configured by the caller/type context; `bindings.parties` is configured by the caller/type context; `bindings.sources` is configured by the caller/type context; `bindings.template` is configured by the caller/type context.
